annotations.title: Draft one action family's change to the saved company execution policy and preview it

description: Draft one action family's change to the saved company execution policy and preview it. widen adds an automatic rule for a family that reports.autonomy_calibration marks ready_to_widen: at least 30 decided plans and under 1% errors in 14 days. hold adds the family's kill switch: a review rule with threshold 100 that holds every action in the family whatever the other rules say. Returns the drafted settings, the expected version and the autonomy.policy.preview result with its preview_hash. Saves nothing; a person publishes the change with autonomy.policy.update. Money stays within the policy's money limits, and Slack posts still wait unless a rule names Slack.

change.description: widen adds an automatic rule for a family the calibration report marks ready_to_widen. hold adds the family's kill switch: a review rule with threshold 100. Either way nothing is saved.

threshold.description: For widen: the confidence each action in the family needs. Default: the policy's default threshold.
